scope: Exploratory replication on 25 added earlier weekdays plus 22 previously inspected days. First ten chronological days initialize; all later fits and weekly selection use mature past labels only. No inherited August-trained flags, no equity/PnL/sizing in selection. Fixed finite comparisons, all reported. July 3 is shortened; July 27-30 omitted from this five-week extension; July 31 missing in canonical source. Contract/day/gap boundaries explicit. Bid is a reference, not an executable long fill.

limits: Causal feature builders reused; native target paths, probability coefficients, selection arithmetic and account replay reconstructed independently.
Finite exploratory comparisons and descriptive day bootstrap, no untouched holdout or persistent-market-edge claim.

online_verification.limits: Second exploratory stage selected after primary results; causal arithmetic does not establish persistent prediction skill.
